$comment: The closed vocabularies of this corpus, in ONE place.
Python reads it (scripts/lint.py, scripts/index.py). TypeScript imports it
(docs/lib/status.ts). Before this file the same lists were written out by
hand in nine places -- the linter, the README prose, a status union in
docs/lib/source.ts, and badge colours hard-coded in five page components --
and they disagreed. docs/lib/source.ts admitted a 'Stagnant' no file has
ever carried and omitted the status 52 files DID carry, so every one of
those rendered with the fallback badge and counted toward nothing.
A value is only in this file because a proposal needs it. Adding one is a
decision about the corpus, not about a renderer.

Draft.means: Proposed. Nothing implements it yet, or the document itself describes work still ahead. Argue with it; do not build against it.

Final.means: The thing it specifies exists in the code. The spec is settled -- changing it takes a new HIP.

Living.means: A document that never finishes: governance and process, amended in place rather than replaced.

type.Standards Track: describes a thing we build and maintain
type.Process: how we work: numbering, branch names, what is public

folded.$comment: Every spelling this corpus has carried, and the value it is now. Kept so a reader of an old commit, an old PR or an external link can tell what happened. Nothing may be written back into a HIP from this map.
folded.Active: Final for a Standards Track spec; Living for Meta and Process
folded.Superseded: deleted -- the successor carries the text
folded.Stagnant: never written in a HIP; existed only in the site's type
